source_admission.scope: A narrow corrected factual assertion; no broader intent or universal-falsity conclusion.
source_admission.same_target_correspondence: Entity, period, units, concept, consolidation context and retrospective correction basis verified; not an unrelated estimate, policy adoption or merely differently scoped comparable.
source_admission.chronology_limit: Informative primary chronology plus targeted checks supports the required year gate; no universal absence or absolute earliest-day proof is claimed.

process_adherence.local_guard: Recorded sequential owner and pending-state guard verified; not an authenticated atomic lock or production-wide interception.
process_adherence.query_binding_limit: Search query wording is retained, but the provider does not independently echo the exact query. Local observation is not a network-dispatch witness.
process_adherence.adaptation: Changes address actual earlier returns and evidence gaps; original availability checked early.
process_adherence.timing_label_clarification: Frozen source elapsed time is the interval through local closure; all recorded intervals satisfy the cap.
process_adherence.version_clarification: Prospectively recorded; no initial commitments or admission gates rewritten.

projection_readiness.required_followup: Independently review the new combined mapping, control preservation, exact input and scorer-only gold. Encode day-only publication metadata without an invented clock; retain the separately verified availability basis.

nonidentifying_limitations: Complete delivered reader text is not a raw-document or visual-facsimile claim.
One incomplete later document representation and its failed visual route remain clearly distinguished from the usable primary evidence.
The terminal-newline check was resolved with exact independent reconstruction; no substantive text mismatch remains.
The pass stopped at its operation cap, not global source-route exhaustion. A distinct route could improve the broader dossier; identical failed routes are retired from automatic repetition.
Source admission and process adherence are separate from factual accuracy measured by a model trial; no accuracy gain or causal benefit is claimed.
